name: The Ritual
source:
"Deep in the bowels of the Black Tower dwells a wicked and contemptible sorceress: Quintessa - The Maiden of Pain! Her depraved arcane machinations seek to drown the realm in her devious debaucheries, but such maniacal machinations require energy! Erotic energy, to be specific...the kind only a creature of insatiable sexual hunger can provide!   

But, Quintessa has many plates to juggle, and can't be arsed to handle it all...that's where you come in..!

[From [url=https://sneakattack1221.itch.io/the-ritual]Itch.io[/url]]
